title: Revenue up, margin down in Q3
demonstrates: Parallel time-series, discount and product-mix analysis, with the quarter named in the question driving the comparison window.
question: Revenue increased in Q3 2025, but gross margin fell. What caused it?

report.question: Revenue increased in Q3 2025, but gross margin fell. What caused it?
report.executive_summary: revenue rose from 1,412,235 in 2025-04-01 to 1,710,010 in 2025-07-01 (297,774.67). gross_margin_pct fell from 40.87% in 2025-04-01 to 33.24% in 2025-07-01, a change of 7.63 percentage points. Across category, Apparel has the highest revenue at 1,522,302 and Toys & Games the lowest at 825,693.
key_findings: gross_margin_pct fell from 40.87% in 2025-04-01 to 33.24% in 2025-07-01, a change of 7.63 percentage points.
Across category, Apparel has the highest revenue at 1,522,302 and Toys & Games the lowest at 825,693.
Across acquisition_channel, affiliate has the highest revenue at 1,511,561 and referral the lowest at 832,817.
Electronics accounts for 80.3% of the change in revenue, the largest single contribution across category.
Of the -7.63 point change in gross_margin_pct, -3.76 comes from rate movement within category values and -3.67 from the mix shifting between them; within-segment rate movement is the larger part.

res_3462958be07d.sql:
WITH base AS (
SELECT date_trunc('quarter', order_date) AS period, SUM(quantity * unit_price) AS "revenue"
FROM (
SELECT
  o.order_id,
  o.order_date,
  o.customer_id,
  o.channel            AS order_channel,
  o.discount_rate,
  o.shipping_cost,
  o.status,
  o.is_first_order,
  i.order_item_id,
  i.product_id,
  i.quantity,
  i.unit_price,
  i.unit_cost,
  i.list_price,
  i.discount_amount,
  p.category,
  p.brand,
  c.region,
  c.customer_segment,
  c.acquisition_channel,
  CASE WHEN r.return_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS is_returned,
  COALESCE(r.refund_amount, 0)                    AS refund_amount,
  r.return_reason
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products p    ON p.product_id = i.product_id
JOIN customers c   ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
LEFT JOIN returns r ON r.order_item_id = i.order_item_id
) AS m WHERE "order_date" BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY date_trunc('quarter', order_date)
ORDER BY date_trunc('quarter', order_date)
)
SELECT period, "revenue",
  LAG("revenue") OVER (ORDER BY period) AS prev_period,
  ROUND("revenue" - LAG("revenue") OVER (ORDER BY period), 6) AS change_abs,
  ROUND(100.0 * ("revenue" - LAG("revenue") OVER (ORDER BY period))
        / NULLIF(ABS(LAG("revenue") OVER (ORDER BY period)), 0), 4) AS change_pct
FROM base
ORDER BY period

WITH base AS (
SELECT date_trunc('quarter', order_date) AS period, 100.0 * (SUM(quantity * unit_price) - SUM(quantity * unit_cost)) / NULLIF(SUM(quantity * unit_price), 0) AS "gross_margin_pct"
FROM (
SELECT
  o.order_id,
  o.order_date,
  o.customer_id,
  o.channel            AS order_channel,
  o.discount_rate,
  o.shipping_cost,
  o.status,
  o.is_first_order,
  i.order_item_id,
  i.product_id,
  i.quantity,
  i.unit_price,
  i.unit_cost,
  i.list_price,
  i.discount_amount,
  p.category,
  p.brand,
  c.region,
  c.customer_segment,
  c.acquisition_channel,
  CASE WHEN r.return_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS is_returned,
  COALESCE(r.refund_amount, 0)                    AS refund_amount,
  r.return_reason
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products p    ON p.product_id = i.product_id
JOIN customers c   ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
LEFT JOIN returns r ON r.order_item_id = i.order_item_id
) AS m WHERE "order_date" BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY date_trunc('quarter', order_date)
ORDER BY date_trunc('quarter', order_date)
)
SELECT period, "gross_margin_pct",
  LAG("gross_margin_pct") OVER (ORDER BY period) AS prev_period,
  ROUND("gross_margin_pct" - LAG("gross_margin_pct") OVER (ORDER BY period), 6) AS change_abs,
  ROUND(100.0 * ("gross_margin_pct" - LAG("gross_margin_pct") OVER (ORDER BY period))
        / NULLIF(ABS(LAG("gross_margin_pct") OVER (ORDER BY period)), 0), 4) AS change_pct
FROM base
ORDER BY period

res_0ba3246fcf51.sql:
WITH base AS (
SELECT "category" AS "category", SUM(quantity * unit_price) AS "revenue"
FROM (
SELECT
  o.order_id,
  o.order_date,
  o.customer_id,
  o.channel            AS order_channel,
  o.discount_rate,
  o.shipping_cost,
  o.status,
  o.is_first_order,
  i.order_item_id,
  i.product_id,
  i.quantity,
  i.unit_price,
  i.unit_cost,
  i.list_price,
  i.discount_amount,
  p.category,
  p.brand,
  c.region,
  c.customer_segment,
  c.acquisition_channel,
  CASE WHEN r.return_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS is_returned,
  COALESCE(r.refund_amount, 0)                    AS refund_amount,
  r.return_reason
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products p    ON p.product_id = i.product_id
JOIN customers c   ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
LEFT JOIN returns r ON r.order_item_id = i.order_item_id
) AS m WHERE "order_date" BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY "category"
ORDER BY "category"
)
SELECT "category", "revenue",
  CASE WHEN MIN("revenue") OVER () >= 0 THEN
    ROUND(100.0 * "revenue" / NULLIF(SUM("revenue") OVER (), 0), 4)
  END AS share_of_total_pct,
  ROUND("revenue" - MAX("revenue") OVER (), 6) AS diff_vs_best,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "revenue" DESC NULLS LAST) AS rank_desc
FROM base
ORDER BY "revenue" DESC NULLS LAST
